bio.intro: I’m a Senior Full Stack Developer with 6+ years building web products end to end, from the database and the API to the interface.
bio.current: I currently work at <highlight>SmartJob</highlight> for <highlight>Falabella Seller Center</highlight>, on the Promotions team. I take part in the team’s architecture decisions, lead a group of developers through the design and implementation of new features, and stay hands-on in the code. The promotions we build are used by sellers in Chile, Colombia and Peru.
bio.stack: My work covers the whole stack: React, Next.js and Angular on the client, including microfrontend architectures; Node.js with NestJS and Fastify, Spring Boot and Python on the server; and PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL and Oracle for data. On FactuPro, an invoicing platform I build and operate, I also own the AWS infrastructure, defined in Terraform.
bio.leadership: On the leadership side, I decide with the team how features should be built, break initiatives into deliverables, review code and mentor developers.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: Selected projects, each with its context, my role and what I worked on. Client work is described without confidential details.

armada-reserve.title: Armada Reserve - Repo Trading Desk (FinTech)
armada-reserve.role: Freelance · Armada Global LLC, through Latam Hire
armada-reserve.description: A platform for repurchase agreement (repo) trading desks that manages the full trade lifecycle, from entry and pre-trade compliance to settlement.
highlights: Delivered features across the Next.js trading desk and client portal and the NestJS API.
Those features included Auth0 MFA and step-up authentication, provider-aware settlement and wallet flows with digital-asset custody, and accounting records.
Hardened the Kubernetes infrastructure behind SOC 2 controls.

falabella-seller-center.title: Falabella Seller Center - Promotions
falabella-seller-center.role: SmartJob · Technical leadership and hands-on development
falabella-seller-center.description: The promotions area of Falabella Seller Center, used by sellers in Chile, Colombia and Peru, where promotional flows are configuration-driven to follow each country’s requirements.
highlights: Take part in architecture decisions for the team’s microfrontends and configuration-driven promotional flows.
Lead a group of developers: define how each feature is built, break initiatives into deliverables, and review code.
Set the patterns for reusable React + TypeScript components and mentor teammates.
Stay hands-on in the code, working closely with product, design and backend teams.

eeasa-operations-logbook.title: EEASA - Electric Utility Operations Logbook
eeasa-operations-logbook.role: Full stack · Angular frontend and Spring Boot API
eeasa-operations-logbook.description: Operations logbook for Empresa Eléctrica Ambato (EEASA), an electric utility in central Ecuador. Control center and call center staff record faults, incidents, and operational events, manage work orders, and document field crew work with photos.
highlights: Worked on role-based access, operational dashboards, and Excel/PDF reports, including the reports for Ecuador’s national grid operator (CENACE).

nih-hits.title: NIH - HITS Platform (USA)
nih-hits.description: HITS is a platform at the U.S. National Institutes of Health (NIH) for exploring compound screening data, with table, gallery and plate views, keyword search, condition-based filters, and drug-combination synergy matrices.
highlights: Developed and optimized features of the platform, working with Angular microfrontends, NestJS and PostgreSQL.

smart-irb.title: Smart-IRB - New Version (Top U.S. Universities)
smart-irb.description: New version of Smart-IRB, used by leading U.S. universities, including Harvard.
highlights: Delivered frontend features in an Angular microfrontend architecture with PrimeNG.
Built backend services with NestJS on PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

certero.title: CERTERO - Certificate Issuance & Verification (Blockchain)
certero.description: A blockchain-based platform for issuing and verifying certificates.
highlights: Built and refined user-facing flows and integrations across the certification lifecycle, working with cross-functional teams.

safetrack.title: Safetrack - QR Labeling & Traceability
safetrack.description: A traceability solution for product labeling and authenticity verification, using QR codes and blockchain-backed records.
highlights: Delivered the purchase order management module.
Delivered traceability and reporting features.

factupro-v2.title: FactuPro v2 - Cloud Invoicing Platform (Web, Mobile & AWS)
factupro-v2.role: I build and operate it end to end
factupro-v2.description: Second generation of FactuPro, an electronic invoicing platform for businesses in Ecuador. A new Next.js web client and a React Native (Expo) mobile app share the Express API and add modules such as restaurant table and order management.
highlights: Moved the platform from Heroku to AWS, with the infrastructure defined in Terraform.
Docker containers on an ARM64 EC2 instance, with database migrations on every deploy.
Deployment pipelines with GitHub OIDC.
Signing certificates stored encrypted, with the key held in AWS SSM.

factupro-v1.title: FactuPro v1 - Electronic Invoicing System (Ecuador SRI)
factupro-v1.description: First version of FactuPro, in production since 2020 for several companies.
highlights: Angular frontend and Node.js/Express API that generate electronic invoices, sign them with XAdES-BES, and send them to Ecuador’s tax authority (SRI).
Builds the PDF invoice and emails it to the customer.
Payment integration, sales reports, and Excel/PDF exports.

weather-app.title: Weather App - Real-Time Forecast
weather-app.description: This is a sample Angular project that demonstrates how to use the OpenWeather and VisualCrossing APIs to create an admin panel and a daily weather visualization.

portfolio-v2.title: Personal Portfolio - 2026 (Version 2)
portfolio-v2.description: Second iteration of my personal portfolio, built with Next.js and modern frontend tooling. Focused on clean UI, performance, SEO, and clear presentation of professional experience and real-world projects.

portfolio-v1.title: Personal Portfolio - 2020 (Version 1)
portfolio-v1.description: First version of my personal portfolio, developed as an early-career project. It showcases my initial work in frontend development and marks the starting point of my professional growth as a software developer.

clinical-records-backend.title: Clinical Records Backend - Municipal Health Center (Thesis Project)
clinical-records-backend.description: Backend system for managing clinical histories, developed as my university thesis for the Municipal Patronage of Latacunga. Designed to handle patient records, medical consultations, and secure data access for healthcare personnel.
